changes: Implemented the B-ec3b indexed runtime memory M0-M2 slice: profiling/report-only baseline, derived playbook memory index with atomic rebuild/read validation, and indexed two-stage candidate retrieval wired into MemoryFreshnessPack generation while preserving gateEvidence=false.
usage: Runtime memory consumers continue calling existing playbook memory pack/session/handoff paths; the indexed path is an internal acceleration layer validated by playbook-runtime-memory-index-smoke.js and related MVP smokes.
expectedOutcome: Proofbound can consume active playbook memory through a validated derived index without making memory authoritative proof, with stale or malformed index data falling back safely.
actualTranscript: Build PASS; playbook-runtime-memory-index-smoke PASS for M0/M1/M2; MVP1 smoke PASS 11/11; MVP2 smoke PASS 9/9; baseline smoke PASS; health smoke PASS; story_advance TEST ran configured validate commands and passed; done_prepare validation passed after merge-main.
outcomeDiff: No difference for B-ec3b scope: M0-M2 are implemented and verified. M3-M8 rollout/cache/enforcement milestones remain outside this story and are not claimed here.
limitations: This story completes only M0-M2 indexed runtime memory. It does not claim M3-M8 consumer rollout/enforcement, full 1M optimized parity as a mandatory DONE gate, or Authority Server completion semantics.
pitfalls: Claude CLI was unavailable because it was not logged in, and agy did not return a usable B-ec3b verdict, so DONE review-assurance uses the one-host local floor only; one earlier autopilot_review_submit lacked binding digests and is ignored by the gate.
